speaker: Doctor
text: Let's start with your age and any history of similar symptoms in your family. Can you describe exactly when the double vision started and if it changes when you look up or down?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: That pattern of weakness worsening with activity and improving with rest is very telling. Does the double vision ever disappear completely for a few minutes at a time, and do you experience any drooping of your eyelids? Also, do you have difficulty swallowing or speaking?

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had recent infections or fevers, and there is no family history of neurological disease. The weakness feels symmetrical in both arms and legs.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. REQUEST IMAGES: CT_Chest to evaluate for thymoma.
